# Improved settings and EPUB illustration viewing

This X4 Pro release makes the settings screen denser and easier to scan, and adds a fullscreen way to browse a book's illustrations without paging through the text.

## Added

- Added Lucide icons to every item in the main settings tabs.
- Added a fullscreen EPUB illustration viewer, available from the reader menu.
- Illustration navigation follows the configured reader controls, including taps, swipes, side buttons, and remapped page-turn buttons.

## Improved

- Increased the X4 Pro settings screen capacity from 8 to 10 visible rows.
- Replaced textual On/Off values with Lucide toggle icons, including a filled knob for the enabled state.
- Added missing Russian translations for reader and frontlight settings.
- Illustration images preserve their aspect ratio and are extracted one at a time to limit storage and memory use.

## Removed

- Removed settings for showing hidden files, removing completed books from Continue Reading, and moving completed books to the Read folder. These behaviors remain disabled.

## Notes

- This is an X4 Pro-only firmware release containing only `firmware-x4pro.bin`.
